title: Account Executive (m/w/d) im Außendienst - Frankfurt
description:
Du fühlst dich im Vertrieb zu Hause und möchtest ein eigenes Gebiet im Außendienst aufbauen und verantworten? Bei uns heißt das: Verantwortung übernehmen, kurze Sales-Zyklen betreuen, ungedeckelte Provision verdienen und echte Entwicklungschancen nutzen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

• You have experience working with suppliers and contract manufacturers on design validation and manufacturing.

Our organization achieves this by providing high-quality and timely data-driven research to public officials at all levels of government - city, state, national, regional, and international - as well as to civil society and the media. The ICCT offers a mission-driven and culturally diverse workplace where intelligence, flexibility, transparency, and good humor are highly valued. • Engage with external stakeholders, including government officials, policymakers, NGOs, academic experts, or industry partners.

You will work primarily on backend services and RESTful APIs in Go and other languages, modernize legacy control-plane workflows, and improve the reliability and scalability of production systems. title: Head of Story & Communications
description:
ClickHouse has a lot worth saying. The database has become a platform for real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads. Many of the most interesting AI and software companies of the last few years run on it. Our founders and leaders hold clear, well-formed views on where data and AI are heading. And every week the customer base produces proof points most companies would build a campaign around. What we have not yet built is the function whose job it is to turn all of that into one story the market hears consistently, and from us.

We are looking for a Senior Director, Story & Communications to build that function from the ground up. You'll own the company narrative: what ClickHouse should be known for, how the platform story gets told above the level of features, and how the proof we generate adds up to a thesis. And you'll build the machine that carries it into the world: the announcement calendar, press and media relationships across technology and business media, and executive platforms for our founders and leaders. This is a build role and a player-coach role. You won't inherit a team; you'll hire one as the function grows, directing our agency partners in the meantime and staying in the work yourself. You'll report to the VP of Global Marketing and work closely with the executive team, product marketing, and the people closest to our customers.

What You Will Be Doing

- Define what ClickHouse should be known for and turn it into a rolling narrative and communications strategy that the marketing and executive teams work from

- Build the communications machine: announcement calendar and tiering, press materials, holding statements, a reporter cadence, and launch amplification, directing agency partners and holding them to outcomes

- Own press and media relations across technology and business media, taking the ClickHouse story beyond the tech press and re-educating the market on the full platform

- Build executive platforms for our founders and leaders: the themes each owns, the moments and formats worth their time, and a clear way to evaluate inbound podcast, mainstage, and sponsored event opportunities

- Shape quarterly release moments and major launches so they earn attention and show up consistently across press, social, community, and the field

- Set the standard for how ClickHouse sounds in public: voice, quality bar, and the discipline that every published claim, number, and proof point is approved, current, and consistent

- Hire and lead the team as the function grows, and build the planning and review rhythm that keeps narrative, communications, and social aligned

What You Bring Along

- Experience building or rebuilding a communications function at a growth-stage infrastructure, developer, or data company

- A record of landing stories in tier-one business media as well as technology press, with the relationships and news judgment to do it again

- Experience working directly with a CEO and executive team: shaping their points of view, preparing them, and declining opportunities not worth their time

- Media-company operator instincts: you think in themes, arcs, and audiences

- Player-coach approach: you write and edit yourself, give useful feedback, and set the bar by example

- Comfort with a technical product and a technical audience, including credibility with engineers and developers

- Experience directing agencies to outcomes, with judgment about what belongs in-house

- Analytical grounding: you track what is landing, form a view on why, and use it to decide where to focus

title: Senior Partner Solutions Engineer, Technical Partnerships
locationText: Remote in the United States or Canada (West Coast/PT) · Remote
description:
At Sanity.io http://Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

The Senior Partner Solutions Engineer owns both the technical work and the relationship for a portfolio of Sanity's technology partners. You scope, prototype, and review the technical side of partner solutions and you also manage the partner relationship itself, the business conversations and day-to-day project management. You report to the VP, Technical Partnerships.

Most integrations ship through the partner's own engineering team or Sanity R&D-your job is to make sure what gets built is the right thing, built the right way, and that the partnership itself stays healthy and productive.

WHAT YOU WOULD DO:

- Partner Relationship & Strategic Advisory

- Own the relationship with a portfolio of partners: the project plan, the roadmap, the business conversation, and the technical scoping, as one continuous thread

- Lead conversations with partner business and product leaders, moving fluidly between strategic and technical framing

- Assess technical feasibility and effort on the spot well enough to keep a strategic conversation moving, then follow up with real scoping

- Shape partner pitches and joint roadmaps with grounded technical input, so commitments made in the room are ones R&D or the partner can actually deliver

Technical Scoping & Prototyping

- Identify and document the technical opportunity for a partner integration or MCP-based solution: architecture, API surface, data flows, and integration points

- Build prototypes and proofs of concept where they de-risk a build or clarify a design decision. You don’t need to create production-bound code, but enough to validate the approach

- Produce clear technical documentation so a partner's engineering team or Sanity R&D can build to production without re-doing the scoping work

- Navigate partner APIs, SDKs, and technical documentation directly; speak credibly with partner engineers about integration design and trade-offs

- Partner with R&D during build and launch to answer scoping questions and validate the implementation against the original opportunity

Technical Review

- Review partner-built integrations for code quality, security posture, API usage, and joint customer value

- Give partners clear, actionable feedback, and flag systemic gaps back to Product/Engineering

AI & Technical Fluency

- Be fluent in core AI application architecture and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You know enough to scope and prototype confidently, not just evaluate on paper

- Hands-on evaluation of partners' AI product surfaces (model choices, agent tooling, developer experience) to inform scoping decisions

- Identify where Sanity's content platform creates real technical leverage inside an AI-native partner's stack, and document that opportunity clearly enough for someone else to build it

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work with Sanity R&D to hand off scoped opportunities, support them through the build and represent partner needs in the roadmap

- Support Solutions Architects and Sales Engineering with technical assets (reference architectures, prototypes) from your partners

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- The breadth and depth of integrations you own contribute measurably to Sanity product adoption and signup growth from new customers

- Partners and internal stakeholders treat you as a knowledgeable owner of the relationship: both its technical direction and its business trajectory

- R&D and partner engineering teams can pick up your specs and prototypes and build from them without re-doing the scoping work

description:
Laravel is the most popular PHP framework in the world. 500M+ lifetime downloads. Thousands of packages. A developer community that shows up - at conferences, in forums, on Twitter, in Discord servers, and in every “what framework should I use?” thread on the internet.
But Laravel is more than a framework. It is a complete platform - from choosing a stack, to building an app, to deploying it, monitoring it, and scaling it. 8 paid products. 20+ open source packages. One customer journey. When engineering teams evaluate Laravel ’s commercial products, they are not just buying software. They are betting on the platform their developers already love. The AE team is how we turn that love into a business relationship.
We’re early. The GTM motion is still taking shape. There is no massive sales org. There is no 50-page playbook. There is no army of SDRs filling your calendar. What there is: incredible product-market fit, a brand that opens every door, and a growing team of talented people who care deeply about doing this right.
Why this job is unique

• You are selling to developers with strong, informed opinions and a low tolerance for inauthenticity.

• Earning technical credibility matters, even if you are not an engineer.

• You will operate in real ambiguity and help shape how we go to market.

• Sales is a team sport here. SE, marketing, product, and engineering are true partners.

What you will do

•
Build genuine customer partnerships. Run sales cycles end-to-end, while thinking far beyond the signature.

•
Navigate technical sales with credibility. Hold your own in a room full of engineers. Know when to go deep and when to pull in your SE.

•
Collaborate across the org. Partner tightly with your SE. Work with marketing to advance deals. Bring customer context to product and engineering with empathy for constraints.

•
Thrive in the early days. Build pipeline, create clarity from ambiguity, and put processes in place as you learn.

Requirements
What the ideal candidate brings

•
Growth mindset. Enjoys experimentation and iteration while we establish our sales process.

•
Customer-first instincts. Focus on customer value, not just deal size.

•
Grit and resourcefulness. Proven ability to navigate chaos without checking out.

•
Technical curiosity. Learns concepts proactively to maintain credibility with technical audiences.

•
Collaborative DNA. Strong cross-functional partnerships, with specific examples of contribution.

•
Comfort with early-stage. Enjoys building the plane while flying it.

Benefits

• Fully remote, globally distributed team

• Option to attend Laracon conferences around the world

• Paid time off (vacation, sick leave, public holidays)

• Family leave (maternity, paternity)

• Company equity

• Access to high quality training tools to ensure you are enabled to be the best you can be.

• Welcome kit with custom Laravel swag

title: Manager, Professional Services & Consulting
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Manager of Professional Services to join our team. This is a Costa Rica role, reporting to the Director of Professional Services AMS in the Professional Services department. You will lead the delivery and post-sales deployment programs for our clients. In this role, you’ll oversee a high-performing team of technical consultants and project managers, ensuring customer-centric excellence while driving the efficiency, scalability, and profitability of our cloud security solutions.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

•
Lead and manage a technical team of consultants and project managers responsible for Zscaler solution deployments and support in the AMS Central Region

•
Own the hiring, onboarding, development, and performance management for the team to ensure high-quality delivery

•
Manage cross-functional relationships across Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, and Support to drive successful deployments

•
Participate in long-term planning and strategic decision-making with global partners, including PS Sales and Practice leads

•
Drive operational excellence through process improvement, tooling, and the effective management of KPIs to enhance automation and reduce manual effort

Who You Are (Success Profile)

•
You thrive in ambiguity, comfortably building the path as you walk it and seeing dynamic environments as opportunities to build something meaningful.

•
You act like an owner with a strong bias for action, operating with integrity and seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

A little about us
When it comes to food experience, me&u helps you always feel like a local. The company's vision is to bring that feeling to everyone, anywhere. No matter what neighbourhood you live in or visit, you'll always know the perfect place to go and exactly what to order.
me&u is used by 6000+ bars, pubs, and restaurants to create memorable guest experiences and grow their brands. With 200 staff in five countries, and headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, me&u is the consolidation of two leading hospitality technology companies: Mr Yum and me&u, who merged in November 2023.

The Engineering role is changing.
We're looking for a Staff or Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our Reservations stream. You'll take on ambiguous problems, own solution design and help shape the technical direction of the systems your team builds. We’re looking for someone whose judgment and standards lift the work of the whole team, not just their own.
We believe in full-breadth engineers, a.k.a the uncomfortably named 'broken comb' shaped people with multiple areas of expertise, who can deliver value end-to-end in a small, fully cross-functional team.
We build AI-natively. Agents do most of the implementation here; engineers shape the problem, write the specs and context that let agents succeed, and own the quality of what ships. You'll be expected to work this way from day one and lead by example, setting the standard for how the team works with agents. What good context looks like, which guardrails are executable rather than written down, and when AI output is good enough versus when it needs a human hand.
We already work this way: the AFR profiled how our engineers run agents overnight so their days go to customers and problems, not keyboards.

What you'll do

•
Co-create with product and design: Sit in discovery & hear directly from customers. Then bring your technical acumen into shaping, and turn intent into specs and story slices that both humans and agents can work from.

•
Direct and verify, then ship: Plan work so agents can execute it, review their output for logic and design rather than syntax, and take accountability for what lands in production.

•
Build the foundations agents inherit: Maintain the context files, skills, hooks, architectural lint rules and regression suites that make our codebases safer to delegate into over time, not riskier.

•
Own solution and system design: Lead the design of initiatives and features, working with product, design and the relevant custodianship leads to validate ideas and make trade-offs. Think across components and domains so solutions fit the system as a whole and the business goals behind them.

•
Code reviews: Review AI-generated and human-written PRs with the same rigour. Enforce our conventions, make actionable suggestions, and help decide which classes of change can eventually be trusted with lighter review.

•
Collaboration and mentorship: Pair with and mentor less experienced team members, including on how to work well with agents. Actively create room for mid-level engineers to grow, and make sure the team's use of AI consistently lifts its output.

•
Knowledge sharing and technical leadership: Champion our engineering principles, take part in our engineering guilds and help shape our architecture and practices. When customer needs, tech debt and delivery pace pull in different directions, make a clear directional call and document the reasoning so people and agents can make follow-on decisions without escalating.

•
Own the outcome: Guide your own work and the people and agents working alongside you towards timely, efficient delivery. Before shipping customer-facing changes, think through second-order effects, including support load, venue operations and billing edge cases, and adjust the approach without being asked. Own the customer outcome and the systems you build. Your job is to deliver value to our customers, not to get the code into production.

title: Director, Commercial Strategy & Operations
description:

ClickHouse runs on a usage-based pricing model, which makes pricing strategy and commercial system design foundational: the pricing model, packaging, rules, guardrails, discount governance, approval workflows, and marketplace mechanics have to be designed early and built into the system, not retrofit later. The same discipline applies to new products: the commercial infrastructure that makes them sellable has to be built before they ship.
Reporting to the VP, Revenue Operations, you will own the commercial surface of the GTM system end-to-end: the pricing strategy, the packaging, and the rules, automation, and exception review that govern how deals get structured, approved, and closed, and the commercial readiness that makes a new product sellable on day one. • Build out Q2C and CPQ automation. Drive the platform roadmap with Revenue Engineering.

Build the commercial infrastructure that makes a new product sellable before it ships: the pricing and packaging, the quoting logic, the discount and approval rules, and the controls that govern how the product gets sold. Program-manage the cross-functional path to launch across Product, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Engineering: define the commercial requirements, drive the build, test the end-to-end flow, and own the go-live readiness so the product is sellable on day one.

• Hire and develop the Commercial Strategy & Operations team. Design the systems and review logic that let a small team govern an increasing volume of deal flow as the business scales.

• Partner with Product and Finance on pricing and packaging changes: lead the analysis, design the operational rollout, instrument the rollout in the system, and measure the results

What You Bring Along

title: Regulatory Compliance Manager
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Regulatory Compliance Manager you will support the Head of Compliance in running the compliance function of Vinted Pay Limited. You will own the compliance monitoring programme, keep our policies and procedures current as the rules change, advise colleagues on what those rules mean in practice, and make sure that compliance issues are recorded, escalated and closed.

You will report to the Head of Compliance and act on their behalf in their absence. This is a second line of defence role: you operate independently of business and commercial decision-making and carry no revenue or sales targets.

In this position, you’ll 

• Support the Head of Compliance in running the compliance function

• Participate in implementation and periodical review of the compliance monitoring programme, and carry out monitoring activities, control testing and effectiveness reviews.

• Identify and assess compliance risks across the company and put proportionate measures in place to mitigate them.

• Run regulatory horizon scanning and work out what regulatory developments mean for us in practice, then see the required changes through.

• Draft, review and maintain the compliance policies and procedures so that they keep pace with legal and regulatory change.

• Take part in the New Product Approval Process and advise colleagues on how applicable requirements apply to a specific product, process or initiative.

• Register and manage compliance incidents and remediation actions, and run the escalation process and the regulatory requirements register.

• Own the conflicts of interest framework, and organise and deliver compliance training.

• Respond to regulatory requests, and support the Head of Compliance in audits and inspections and in reporting to Committees and the Board of Directors.

About you 

• Have solid experience in a regulatory compliance function, preferably within a payment institution, electronic money institution, bank or another regulated financial institution.

• In-depth knowledge of EMRs, PSRs and FCA requirements that apply to electronic money institutions, including Consumer Duty, Operational Resilience, Safeguarding and AML/CTF requirements

• Demonstrated ability to build and run a compliance monitoring programme and to turn regulatory change into concrete internal action.

• Able to advise the business in plain language.

• Comfortable working independently and making informed decisions under time pressure.

• Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills,

Our platform handles prescription intake, data entry, refill management and patient calls. It works on top of the systems pharmacies already run, across 26+ pharmacy management systems and the portals and tools around them, so teams can take on more volume with the same staff. Today TJM Labs supports more than 550 pharmacies across the U.S. and Canada and automates over a million pharmacy tasks a day.

ABOUT US

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We’re hiring a Commercial Counsel to be a core member of Sierra’s legal team. We are looking for someone who has deep expertise in commercial contracts, but also someone who is eager to broaden their scope across IP, regulatory, and product. You will thrive in dynamic environments, enjoy tackling challenges beyond your comfort zone, and be excited to contribute across the business. In return, we’ll provide the support and opportunities you need to grow and excel as a lawyer. You’ll be part of a legal team that is highly respected within both the company and the broader legal industry-committed to excellence, collaboration, and making a meaningful impact.

- Commercial Contracting: Structure, negotiate, and advise on all commercial contracts, including SaaS subscription agreements, technology licenses, professional services agreements, channel partner agreements, vendor agreements, and NDAs. Commercial privacy and security contracting experience (e.g., DPAs, BAAs, security agreements) is a plus.

- Operational Excellence: Help build out our commercial function to be best-in-class. We aim to be the fastest and strongest, where the legal team is the differentiator in the contract lifecycle. You will be developing templates, playbooks, and workflows to drive efficiency and scalability.

- Expertise: Deep knowledge of practice areas that underpin the commercial practice, including contract law, IP and privacy. You will also want to work in AI and understand the nuances of law as it relates to AI, including the evolving regulatory frameworks. You will be expected to advise broadly on all contractual issues and be comfortable doing so.

- Teamwork: A team player first and foremost. Sierra is a unique place to work, with a strong sense of togetherness, and the legal team is no exception. You will look out for your colleagues and be accustomed to sharing and helping the team succeed.

- Judgment: Understand risk in the context of a hyperscaling business, have sound judgment, and be strategic in your decision-making. You will not be afraid to make judgment calls, and you will be empowered to do so.

- Approach: A strong work ethic with an eye for detail. You will strive for perfection and expect that of others.

- Collaborate: Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, and Agent Development teams to support revenue growth and strategic business initiatives.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 2-6 years of legal experience, with a combination of both large law firm and in-house experience at a tech company.

- A strong background in negotiating and managing complex commercial contracts, preferably in SaaS, AI, or enterprise software.

title: Hardware Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier-physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it’s at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

As CLEAR continues to expand its identity platform across physical and digital environments, our network of kiosks and connected devices forms the backbone of our member experience. Ensuring these systems stay secure, reliable, and always available is mission-critical, and that’s where you come in.

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Hardware Operations and Platform Engineering team. You’ll be sitting at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineer and Embedded Systems Integration. You’ll be architecting and maintaining the software layer that keeps thousands of Linux-based kiosks online, healthy, and self-healing, effectively operating a distributed server fleet at the edge.

You’ll own everything from OS image management to over-the-air (OTA) updates, device observability, and system recovery, while ensuring our biometric kiosks deliver a consistent, frictionless experience to every traveler, every time.

What You Will Do

• Architect and implement OS-level watchdogs, process monitors, and self-healing mechanisms to ensure devices automatically recover from failures (service restarts, reboots, or rollbacks).

• Manage and enhance our OTA update framework to enable safe, atomic updates via A/B partition swapping and automated rollback when needed.

• Develop and maintain Python-based services that interact with connected peripherals (payment terminals, scanners, sensors) via vendor SDKs and serial interfaces.

• Own and maintain our custom Linux image (via Yocto, Buildroot, bootc, rpm-ostree, etc), managing systemd units, udev rules, and security policies for a locked-down, production-grade environment.

• Build lightweight monitoring agents to stream logs, metrics, and telemetry (connectivity, performance, temperature) to centralized observability systems such as Datadog or Splunk.

• Work closely with software, SRE, and field operations teams to identify pain points and develop scalable solutions that improve reliability and ease of maintenance.

Who You Are

• 3+ years of hands-on experience administering embedded Linux systems

• Strong proficiency in Python for system automation, service orchestration, and hardware communication.

• Familiarity with A/B update mechanisms (RAUC, Mender, SWUpdate, or custom partition-switching logic).

• Experienced in serial communications (UART, RS-232, USB-serial) and SDK-based hardware integration.

• Deep knowledge of service dependencies, timers, and watchdog configuration.

• Familiarity with network observability and remote device management at fleet scale.

• Committed to operational excellence, focused on designing for resilience, testability, and safe rollback.

• Collaborative, pragmatic, and curious; equally comfortable debugging a kiosk in the field or improving CI/CD for edge devices.

Why You’ll Love This Role

• Massive impact: Your work ensures millions of travelers experience CLEAR’s identity platform without disruption.

• Unique technical challenge: Operate and scale a distributed edge infrastructure at the intersection of IoT and reliability engineering.

• End-to-end ownership : From OS image to telemetry pipeline, you’ll own the full stack of machine reliability.

• Collaborative culture: Deep cross-functional partnership with engineering and operations experts to create frictionless identity experiences.

• Continuous learning: Work on modern Linux, OTA updates, and observability systems at enterprise scale.

How You’ll be Rewarded:

title: Security Operations Engineer II
locationText: Scottsdale, Arizona, United States; Washington, United States
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As a Security Operations Engineer II, you will be an engineer-first member of Axon's Security Operations Center, the team that monitors, investigates, and responds to security events across Axon's corporate, cloud, and regulated SaaS environments, which serve public safety agencies and enterprises around the world. You will respond to alerts, triage incidents, and participate in the on-call rotation, and use what you learn about day-to-day SOC operations to automate the repetitive work that slows response. You will build automation playbooks, tool integrations, and threat detections, and lead incidents from initial findings through root cause analysis and remediation, turning each one into better detections and playbooks. As automation takes over repeat work, more of your time goes to building the capabilities that let the SOC scale with Axon's growth.

Location:  Onsite at our Scottsdale, AZ or Seattle, WA office
Reports to: Manager, Information Security Engineering
Direct Reports:  None

Your Day-to-Day:

• Investigate and respond to security alerts, security tickets, and user-reported phishing as part of the team's shared queue rotation.

• Participate in the on-call rotation, investigating, containing, and coordinating escalated security events such as exposed credentials, data spillage, suspicious account activity, and cloud account compromise.

• Own incidents through to closure: timeline, root cause, remediation tracking, and a detection or playbook update so the same issue is caught faster next time.

• Identify repetitive, manual work and replace it with automation, such as phishing triage and enrichment, offboarding verification, vulnerability remediation tracking, and bulk ticket handling.

• Write, tune, and document detections against security logs, retire noisy alerts, and write a runbook for every alert you ship.

• Support identity and access operations, including offboarding, access requests, and access reviews, and automate the checks that keep them reliable.

• Produce audit and compliance evidence, and automate its collection wherever possible.

What You’ll Do:

• Design, build, and operate security automation using version control, code review, testing, and CI/CD, including automation playbooks, chat-based workflows, and services that connect security tools.

• Integrate security, identity, IT service management, and cloud platforms through their APIs, handling authentication and secrets securely.

• Own the detection lifecycle: onboard new log sources, write and tune detections, find coverage gaps, and manage detections as code.

• Deploy and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind security tooling using infrastructure-as-code and least-privilege design.

• Build detections and automation that meet strict data-handling and compliance requirements.

• Turn incident lessons into reusable playbooks, templates, and tooling that make response consistent across the team.

• Evaluate new security tooling, including automation platforms and AI-assisted triage, for fit, security, and licensing, and take selected tools into production.

• Measure team workload and the time automation saves, and report metrics that show where to invest next.

• Partner with senior team members on platform design decisions while assisting more junior team members with scripting and automation.

What You Bring:

title: Account Manager
description:
The Garage Door Industry Is in a Gold Rush. We're Leading It.
Private equity is buying up garage door companies at a pace the industry has never seen. That capital is driving up the cost of leads, reshaping how companies compete, and forcing every garage door business to evolve fast.
Most marketing agencies don't understand this. They treat garage door companies like any other home service business, the same playbook they'd use for a plumber or a roofer. They don't understand that a $3M independent competing against a PE backed regional rollup needs a completely different strategy than a locksmith trying to rank on Google.
We do.
Garage Door Marketing Lab is the only marketing agency built exclusively for the garage door industry. Our clients are garage door companies doing $1M to $10M+ in revenue, independents fighting to stay competitive and growth stage operators positioning for scale. We build the marketing systems that drive profitable growth, and we have posted industry record ROAS results doing it: 10.9X, 8X, and 6X.
Our brand is inspired by Apple, Porsche, REI, and Lululemon: premium, modern, best in class.
We Are an AI First Agency. This Is Not Optional.
Every person here uses Claude daily. We build in Claude with VS Code. Real automations are already running in production: our Weekly Marketing Update system, a client tracker that auto syncs Meta, Google PPC, LSA, GoHighLevel leads and Google reviews every day, an automation health watchdog, and a strategy session deck generator.
We believe this is what a marketing agency looks like going forward. If that excites you, and you want to add to it rather than just tolerate it, keep reading. If AI is something you will get around to learning eventually, this is not your seat.
The Role
You will be our clients' primary point of contact: their coach, their advocate, and the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. You own your book of clients and work alongside our specialists in SEO, Google PPC and Advanced Verification, GoHighLevel, and Meta Ads.
Your week:

•
Tuesdays: Deep dive into client ad performance, lead quality, and campaign health

•
Wednesdays: Send concise Weekly Marketing Updates (WMUs) to every client

•
Thursdays: Run your Scorecard in our L10 meeting (we run on EOS)

•
Monthly: Lead 45 minute client meetings on Zoom plus Loom video reports

•
Daily: Monitor client health, respond inside 1 business day, keep Asana current

What You'll Be Measured On

• Client meetings held per week. Goal: 10

• Client show rate. Goal: 90%

• Escalations to CEO. Goal: 0

• Escalations with a solution attached. Goal: 100%

• WMUs groomed before sending. Goal: Yes

• Client Health Dashboard updated. Goal: Yes

• Responsive on Slack. Goal: Yes

Must-Haves (No Exceptions)

•
Account Manager experience at a marketing agency. Agency side, owning client relationships directly. Not general marketing experience. Not a coordinator role. Not in house client success. We do not consider candidates without this.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You will be coaching business owners.

• Proactive problem solver. You fix things before the client notices.

• Comfortable explaining PPC, SEO, and Meta Ads to business owners

• You already use AI in your daily workflow and can show us how

• Video communication skills (Loom, Zoom)

• You can commit to the set Arizona hours and the 90 day term

Strong Advantages

•
7 Figure Agency community member or alumnus. Our single strongest signal.

•
Garage door industry experience. Worked at a garage door company, marketed for one, or sold into the space.

• Home services or trades marketing experience

• GoHighLevel, Google Ads, Meta Ads, or LSA familiarity

• EOS experience (L10s, Rocks, Scorecards)

• SOP building and process improvement track record

• Automations you have built yourself

Logistics
Contract: 1099 independent contractor. You handle your own taxes, insurance, and benefits. 90 day initial term.
Eligible locations: US

AI Development & Integration

About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The ChatGPT team works across research, engineering, product, and design to bring OpenAI’s technology to the world. We serve a diverse audience of users who are already using ChatGPT daily in their lives and work.

We’re looking for a Content Designer to join OpenAI’s Content Design team, bringing deep expertise in prompt engineering and AI evaluation alongside strong content design craft and product judgment.

You’ll combine editorial judgment, product strategy, and technical implementation to build prompts, evaluations, and tools that help us create and improve content and messaging at scale. Your primary focus will be experiences that help people discover ChatGPT’s value, get started, and stay engaged-including notifications-with contributions to broader Content Design work as team needs evolve.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

- Bring 5+ years of experience in content design, content engineering, or a related discipline, with a track record of delivering work across complex product areas.

- Have hands-on experience developing prompts for shipped generative AI experiences and understand model capabilities, limitations, and failure patterns.

- Have designed and implemented content evaluation frameworks-and validated how reliably they assess quality.

- Have hands-on experience using code and APIs to build repeatable generation and evaluation workflows, and can partner with Engineering to integrate them into production.

- Bring strong writing, editorial judgment, and content strategy skills that you can apply across product experiences.

- Can turn qualitative and quantitative evidence into clear recommendations and demonstrate how your work improved content quality, team effectiveness, or product outcomes.

title: Private Equity AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from private equity, as sector specialists or generalists, who build LBOs, returns analyses and portfolio models in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the modelling work of a Private Equity Associate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in private equity or growth equity (buyout, growth or special situations), with a sector focus or generalist deal coverage

- Deep hands-on Excel: LBOs, debt schedules, returns sensitivities, goal seek and circular references

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

The Growth Sales Representative is an individual contributor focusing on renewing, up-selling and cross-selling contracts for an assigned territory through multiple channels (direct and through partners). title: English to Estonian Linguist for Life Sciences
description:
About Welo Life Sciences

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are looking for experienced English into Estonian linguists specializing in Clinical-trials, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory and Medical Devices documents translation.

Key Responsibilities

• Translate clinical research, regulatory, pharmacovigilance and medical devices documents from English to Estonian.

• Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.

• Perform Copy Edit (translation review) of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.

• Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive content.

• Work within the client's CAT tool environment (XTM/Phrase), also Track Changes in Microsoft Word following project-specific setup instructions.

Field of Expertise

• Clinical Research Documents (protocols and synopses, IB, ICF, Patient Sheets, Patient Diaries)

• Regulatory Documents (SmPC, PIL, Labels, CTD Modules)

• Pharmacovigilance Documents (PSUR, DSUR, RMP, SAE and AE)

• Medical Device Documents (Instructions for Use, User Manual, User Interface)

Must-Have Criteria

• Applicant must meet at least one of the following criteria:

Education

• A degree in Translation, Linguistics, or Language Studies (or an equivalent degree) or

• Recognized graduate qualification in any other field, plus a minimum of two years of full-time professional experience in translation or

• A minimum of five years of full-time professional experience in translation

Relevant translation experience

• At least two years of practical translation experience, specifically with life sciences (clinical trials , pharmacovigilance and medical devices) and medical documents

Technical Skills

• Familiarity with CAT tools (XTM/Phrase/MemoQ), License will be provided.

• Familiarity with Track Changes in Microsoft Word

Nice-to-Have

• Degree in Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, Clinical Research, Translation, Linguistics, Philology or similar

• In-house industry experience at a CRO or pharmaceutical company.

Before Applying

Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.

Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).

Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Co

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

You are joining an early-stage scale-up with exceptional product-market fit, backed by over $1 billion in funding from top investors including Atreides, Accel, Benchmark, Bessemer Venture Partners, General Catalyst, ICONIQ, Capital Group, Fidelity and J.P. Morgan. Trusted by leading law firms including White & Case, Linklaters, Cleary Gottlieb and Goodwin. And a world-class team from Google, Klarna, Spotify, Slack, and top-tier consulting and law firms, with infinite room to grow professionally.

The Role

We're looking for a marketing manager to join our Stockholm HQ and lead the execution of high-impact marketing programs across the Nordics, the Netherlands and Poland. This role will play a key part in driving brand awareness, pipeline growth, and customer loyalty through regional field initiatives, including creative brand marketing, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, field marketing, community, and content marketing.

You'll report to the Marketing Director for EMEA and collaborate closely with the global marketing team, including demand generation, product marketing, content, and design. You'll be embedded in the regional go-to-market and engagement teams to plan and execute programs that drive customer acquisition, engage target accounts, and nurture customer relationships. You will play a key role towards achieving new business pipeline, upsell pipeline and renewals targets across the Nordics, the Netherlands and Poland.

What You'll Do

- Build and grow Legora's brand presence across the Nordics, the Netherlands and Poland, ensuring Legora shows up wherever our customers are with consistent positioning and messaging across all regional marketing activities.

- Develop regional marketing strategy and campaign plans, defining objectives, target audiences, messaging themes, and channel mix to drive awareness, engagement, and pipeline contribution.

- Lead the conception and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, coordinating across digital, social, content, and in-person channels to deliver cohesive go-to-market initiatives.

- Design and manage regional field marketing programs, including industry conferences, community events, sponsorships, and Legora-hosted experiences tailored to buyers across the Nordics, the Netherlands, and Poland.

- Partner with the regional sales and partner teams to align marketing initiatives with pipeline goals, account strategies, and customer acquisition priorities.

- Own end-to-end event production, including venue selection, vendor management, attendee communications, GTM enablement, run-of-show planning, content and speaker preparation,
